March 23, 2026

# Removal of pre\_tax\_price from the Order REST Admin API

DateMarch 23, 2026

Flags[Breaking API Change](https://shopify.dev/changelog?filter=breaking-api-change)

SurfacesAPI

Affected APIs[Admin REST API](https://shopify.dev/changelog?api_type=admin-rest)

The `pre_tax_price` and `pre_tax_price_set` fields on order line items in the [REST Admin API](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-rest) are being removed. These fields were previously available to stores with the Avalara AvaTax 1.0 integration enabled, which was deprecated in April 2025.

### What you should do

Use the GraphQL Admin API to access order line item pricing data.
